"name":"Aqua Thermal Spa Experience with Lunch or Afternoon Tea | Monday - Thursday","description":"Enjoy a Two hour Aqua Thermal Journey Followed by either a Two Course Lunch or Afternoon Tea (the food choice is linked to the arrival time, if booking the 10am session then lunch will be booked if booking 1pm arrival afternoon tea will follow). 

- Aqua Thermal With Two Course Lunch.
- Spa use 10.00am - 12.00pm 
- Lunch served after spa use in the hotel restaurant at 12.30pm 

- Aqua Thermal Journey With Full Afternoon Tea
 - Spa use 1.00pm - 3.00pm 
- Afternoon Tea served after Spa Use in Hotel Lounge at 3.30pm.


A truly warming and therapeutic experience. Each heat
experience is taken in turn in order to slowly raise your
body temperature whilst you relax reaping the holistic and
therapeutic benefits of water and heat, you will leave feeling
refreshed and invigorated.

Your experience begins in the Aroma Salt inhalation Room, a
warm, gentle heat. Time to enjoy the relaxing massaging jets of
the Pedidarium on your feet, move on to the warm, moist heat of
the steam room and finish with the intense heat of the Sauna to
warm and relax all your muscles. Cool down in the feature Rain,
Sky & Monsoon shower, before soothing your aching muscles in
the Hydrotherapy Pool – invigorating massage jets then refresh
your body and mind in the Outdoor Spa Bath. 

**Important Information**

Footwear: We kindly request that you bring your own suitable footwear, as this is not provided on the day of your visit. Alternatively, single-use flip-flops are available for purchase at an additional charge.

Dietary Requirements: Please ensure you inform us of any dietary restrictions or allergies in the free text section when confirming your booking. We are unable to accommodate specific needs on the day without prior notice.

Age Restriction: Our spa services are strictly for guests aged 18 and over. If you have any questions regarding this policy, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Medical Conditions and Pregnancy: For your safety, please inform us if you are undergoing treatment for a medical condition or are pregnant. Depending on the circumstances, we may need to adjust or limit the services we provide.
